messages:
sam: CI on master turned red for tests/runtime/concat_test::ConcatUnderLoad. Failing twice in a row on linux-gpu-08 with an assertion `expected size 0 but got 1` in concat_op.cpp:142. build: https://ci.internal/redwood/3609. Anyone seen this recently?
ci-bot: build 3609 failed: tests/runtime/concat_test::ConcatUnderLoad (x2). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3609. Rerun: https://ci.internal/rerun/3609
claire: :eyes: this started after 6a7d9f3 (sam's PR) maybe? can you paste the failing stack/short log?
sam: stack below (trimmed):
```
ASSERT failed at concat_op.cpp:142: expected size 0 but got 1
#0 0x7f8d9ab3 in runtime::ConcatOp::flush() 
#1 0x7f8d9ac8 in runtime::Worker::process_batch() 
#2 0x7f8d9b11 in runtime::ThreadMain
```
Full test name: tests/runtime/concat_test::ConcatUnderLoad
mike: hmm looks like a race/timing window during buffer flush. The assert triggers when an empty buffer is assumed but has one pending entry. Two quick asks: 1) rerun with increased logging (TRACE=concat) to capture timing, 2) run locally `bazel test //tests/runtime:concat_test --runs_per_test=50` to see frequency. Also try `--run_under=taskset 0x1` to pin to one core for debugging.
sam: kicked off CI rerun (https://ci.internal/rerun/3609) and started a local 50x. Locally first 12 passed then failed on iteration 23. Local snippet: `Assertion failed: buffer.empty() (size=1) at concat_op.cpp:142`
tay: if it fails intermittently we should capture the RNG/seed or repro args. Suggest adding `--record-seed` to the unit test harness so we get a seed on failure. Also recommend opening a CI bisection job if we suspect regression between commits. I can drive bisect if you want.
sam: pushed a small debug commit to sam/debug/concat-seed that records seed+thread timings. New CI run shows failing seed=94231. Link: https://ci.internal/build/3612
mike: nice. With seed 94231 we can try deterministic local run: `bazel test //tests/runtime:concat_test --test_arg=--seed=94231 --runs_per_test=1`. If that reproduces reliably we can build a minimal repro harness. Also try `GTEST_FILTER=ConcatUnderLoad` and `TRACE=concat` to get timing.
claire: assigning this to eng-runtime for triage and labeling flaky/regression. @eng-runtime please pick up; if no owner by EOD I'll start a bisect. :mag:
sam: thanks — pinging @mike @claire. I'll attach the debug log and the snippet of the small repro harness I started:```cpp
// repro loop (sketch)
for (int i=0; i<1000; ++i) {
  runtime::ConcatOp op;
  op.push(...);
  // simulate interleaving
  if (i % 7 == 0) std::this_thread::yield();
  op.flush();
}
```
mike: if repro is deterministic with the seed we should be able to run a git bisect across commits in the 6a7d9f3..HEAD range and narrow it down quickly. I'll take the bisect run unless someone else wants it.
claire: add a short-term mitigation: guard the assert with a diagnostic log and allow single-entry flush (so production won't hard-fail until we fix root cause). Add a task to backlog: ENG-5421.
sam: small note — I saw similar symptom in a flaky allocator test a while back; might be related to deferred deletion timing. I'll grep for places that mutate buffer on other threads.
ci-bot: rerun 3609 completed (pass=0 fail=1). Artifact for failing run: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3612/failure.log
mike: taking bisect. I'll update thread with findings. :thumbsup:
claire: thanks all, keep updates here. :spiral_calendar:
